brief_summary: A four-glyph strip showing the leg geometry and spring spec of the Durock T1, Boba U4T, Holy Panda X, and Gateron Lanes side by side against a shared baseline — a steep narrow spike, a D-shaped plateau, a smooth arc blending into the baseline, and a sharper narrow spike than the T1's. Each glyph is paired with its published actuation/bottom-out spread, visualizing that leg shape and spring tune are the two variables that differentiate four switches sharing one mechanism.
data_sources: apps/web/src/content/articles/durock-t1-deep-dive.mdx:'a steeper leading shoulder... the stem leg reaches the contact leaf, crosses it over a shorter arc' and '55g actuation and 67g bottom-out... a 12-gram spread'

apps/web/src/content/articles/gazzew-boba-u4t-deep-dive.mdx:'the POM stem carries a rounded shoulder that maintains contact with the leaf across an extended arc' and '62g actuation and 68g bottom-out, the U4T's spread is only 6 grams'

apps/web/src/content/articles/drop-holy-panda-x-deep-dive.mdx:'a smooth, symmetric arc... a fall-off that blends into the bottom-out rather than dropping off cleanly first' and '60g actuation, 67g bottom-out... A 7-gram delta'

apps/web/src/content/articles/gateron-lanes-tactile-deep-dive.mdx:'a pronounced step on its leading legs — a sharper drop-off on the front face' and 'Gateron specs the switch at 55g actuation with a 62g bottom-out' plus 'a relatively stiff spring'
